title: Collect in Portal is hidden without online payments or portal access
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user. That role holds every permission, including Part sales -> Create & Edit and Invoicing & payments -> Create & Edit.
  2. A test customer exists. If not: top menu Customers -> New Customer, enter a Name (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") and click Save.
  3. Start a new part sale today (a sale started before this release handles cores the old way): top menu Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale; in the New part sale dialog pick the Customer and click Save. The sale opens with the status Estimate.
  4. On the Parts tab click Add Part (on a sale with no parts the Add Part dialog opens by itself). In the Add Part dialog enter Description "Brake Pads", Quantity 1 (required), Vendor = the test vendor and Sell Price $290.91, then click Save & Close. The sale reads Estimate.
  5. Checkable by hand: a shop with online payments off, or a user with no Customer Portal access. Use either: (1) on this test shop, ShopPay turned off (on this QA build no ShopPay switch was found under Settings, so use option 2); or (2) a test role without Customer Portal access - Create the test role: Settings (click your initials at the top right -> Settings) -> Roles & Permissions -> Create Custom Role -> in Choose a template pick e.g. "Parts Manager" -> Apply; untick Customer portal (under Page Access); enter the Role name "ZZAUTOTEST No portal" and click Create. Assign it: Settings -> Staff -> on a spare test user's row click the edit icon -> in Edit Staff Member set Role to "ZZAUTOTEST No portal" -> Save & Close. That user must log out and back in before testing (a role change ends their session).
  6. Not checkable by hand: a Customer Portal that cannot be reached. A manual tester cannot take the portal offline, so that half is left to automation.
custom_steps:
1. Using the shop with ShopPay turned off (or the user without Customer Portal access), open the part sale's Finance tab and click Add Deposit.
  2. In the Create Deposit dialog look for Collect In Portal, then record a deposit with Record Deposit (e.g. $50.00).
  3. Open a service work order the same way and look for Collect In Portal there, for comparison.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • When the shop takes no online payments or the user has no Customer Portal access, Collect in Portal is not shown at all, the same as on the work order.
  • Recording the deposit with Record Deposit still works.
  • Not checkable by hand: when the Customer Portal cannot be reached, the hand-off is treated as declined and Collect in Portal stays disabled. A manual tester cannot take the portal offline, so this part is left to automation.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10269 (Take a deposit on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 8; design canvas boards S8_*; read 5 Oct 2026 (specification edited that day). Source-verified 5 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-N3: “If the Customer Portal cannot be reached, the handoff is treated as declined and stays disabled. Recording the deposit is unaffected”
  • S8-N5: “Collect in Portal is not rendered at all when the shop does not take online payments, or when the user has no Customer Portal access ... S8-R10’s disabled-with-reason state is only for a portal that is asked and actively declines”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
